items.title: AIR InSILo Open Call 2027: when the hourless seeps
items.funding:
Fund: fully funded
Application fee: €7 (solidarity fee; waivers available for displaced persons)
Programme fee: none
Travel: covered (up to €400)
Stay: covered
Living: covered (honorarium up to €2450)
You pay in total: €7
items.eligibility: Visual artists and practitioners focused on place, matter, memory, body, landscape, time; late-emerging and early mid-career preferred; no current undergraduate/graduate students (PhD candidates eligible); no age limit; language: English, German or Russian; IELTS: not required; NET: not required
items.verifyNote: Confirmed open on official site until 30 Dec 2026; funding details consistent across listings
